## Why I'm refreshing this site

I want this website to make my work and growth easier to follow. For recruiters and people considering working with me, it should offer a clear view of what I build, how I think, and what I'm learning.

I'm keeping the existing sections as the foundation. Alongside projects and study notes, I plan to share more stories about the decisions, experiments, and lessons behind the work.

## What I want to share

- What I'm building and the problems I'm trying to solve.
- What I learn along the way, including what doesn't work.
- How my thinking changes as I gain experience.

My current client work includes forward-deployed engineering (FDE) and AI deployment. I plan to give those services a separate website. This site will remain my personal showcase and a record of my progress.

## A small first step

This post starts that next chapter. I'm building on the static site I already have, hosted on GitHub Pages, and making changes one step at a time.
